subject: Media Literacy
title: Programmatic Advertising
description: A quick win: understand Programmatic Advertising.

hook.text: In the time it takes a webpage to load, an auction decides which ad you see. It happens in 100 milliseconds.

buildup.text: Programmatic advertising uses algorithms to buy and place ads automatically, targeting specific users in real time.

discovery.text: Advertisers bid on individual impressions based on your profile. The highest bidder shows you their ad.

twist.text: This system is so complex that brands often don't know where their ads appear — including on harmful content.

climax.text: The ad you just saw was chosen by machines for someone exactly like you, in milliseconds, for profit.

punchline.text: You saw the ad that won the auction for your attention.

quiz.question: What is programmatic advertising?
options: Automated real-time buying and placing of ads targeted to specific users
